newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star sees higher Q4 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star sees higher Q4 EPS.

text.p: Lone Star Industries Inc said on Friday it expected fourth-quarter earnings to exceed the $0.79 per share reported a year earlier.

The company said shipments of cement in October increased from a year ago. Barring an early arrival of cold weather or unexpected operational difficulties, strong cement demand should continue, it said.
Lone Star also said it had repurchased 700,000 shares of its common stock, bringing the total repurchased since November 1995 to 1.6 million shares.
Lone Star has about 10.6 million shares outstanding.
